title: Competitor Trailmap & Field Recon Kit for Model Landscape Surveillance
creator: Ava Morales
description: Build a repeatable, low-overhead Competitor Trailmap and Field Recon Kit for tracking model-provider behavior and regional provisioning signals. Intended outcome: an operational playbook + artifact bundle (probe templates, scoring rubric, dashboards) that PMs/SEs can use to detect early shifts in model availability, latency economics, quant/compatibility regressions, and procurement risk across regions.
scope:
In scope: define signal taxonomy (availability, warm-start latency, quant-compat mismatch, API drift, pricing telemetry); build synthetic probe harness for hosted and dedicated endpoints; scoring pipeline and dashboard; field kit (prompt probes, data capture sheet, stakeholder playbook).
Out of scope: provider contract negotiations, on-prem deployment of competitor models.
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy doc published in Confluence with mappings to data sources
Synthetic probe harness that can run 1k probes/day across regions and models (prototype)
Dashboard wireframe with top-5 early-warning triggers and thresholded alerts
Field Recon Kit (prompt templates, data capture CSV, triage flow) published and validated by Solutions Engineering in 2 customer calls
Runbook for converting detected signals into provisioning or procurement actions (owner + SLAs)
work_items: Draft signal taxonomy and mapping to telemetry (week 1)
Pilot with 2 sales accounts and collect feedback (week 4)
Finalize playbook and handoff to ops & growth (week 5)
notes: This artifact should be consumable by PMs and field SEs without infra access — bundle outputs into a single Confluence page and a zipped Field Kit. Prioritize signals that correlate with customer outages (latency spikes, region-specific model fallbacks) and procurement triggers ( sustained unavailability or price delta > 25%).

risks: False positives from synthetic probes (different user traffic shapes) and vendor anti-scraping policies. Need to avoid creating noise that triggers unwarranted procurement actions. Coordinate with Legal and Security for compliant telemetry. Consider weight adjustments to scoring to reduce sensitivity to single-region blips.
recommendations:
- Use a blended signal (availability + cost delta + latency trend) to escalate to procurement.
- Keep probe cadence conservative initially (hourly) and escalate frequency only for sustained anomalies.
- Translate signals into concrete remediation playbooks (reroute, fallback, reserve capacity trigger).
